adapter.forcing: u_t + (u dot grad)u - nu laplacian(u); analytic, evaluated by the pinned USER_DEFINED_SOLUTION source hook

time.source_time: The pinned driver sets physical time to TimeIter*dt before residual evaluation; final source call is expected at (steps-1)*dt. Record this separately from the printed history clock and completed field time.
time.completed_solution_time: number_of_updates * dt; report separately from the source and history time

sampling.mesh: periodic Cartesian vertex grid on [0,2*pi]^3; remove one duplicated high-side vertex in each periodic axis only after coordinate verification
sampling.phase_relation: vertex phase differs from OpenFOAM cell centers; compare each solver against the same analytic field at its own actual sample coordinates

acceptance.standard: all planned updates completed, process exit 0, SU2 success marker present, and all four declared inner residuals reach log10 <= -10 at every time step
acceptance.interpretation: residual convergence and sampled solution-quality acceptance are separate; sampled derivative maxima do not certify continuum extrema

scope_limits: The historical Gaussian SU2 study remains immutable and is not reinterpreted as this shared-reference study.
This protocol does not claim cross-solver discretizations or sample locations are identical.
The adapter C++ formulas have passed a separate compiled 257-point NumPy parity check; full SU2 build and solver integration remain to be executed.
No physical molecular alignment, deterministic particle location, phase transition, viscosity change, or Navier-Stokes blow-up conclusion follows from this benchmark.
